context: Two teens talk drama club casting after rehearsal
purpose: Teach: ディスカッション/ネイティブ/コミュニティー/劇団/騎士/奮闘/ハッキリ/ブルース

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リハ、お疲れ。さっきの配役のディスカッション、長かったね。
lines.en: Good work at rehearsal. That casting discussion earlier was so long.
lines.style: Casual teen girl, warm and slightly tired after rehearsal

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ほんとだよ。ハッキリ言って、誰が騎士役やるかでみんな揉めすぎ。
lines.en: Seriously. Honestly, everyone was fighting too much over who plays the knight.
lines.style: Casual teen boy, blunt and slightly exasperated, frank tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもリク、あんたの英語ネイティブ並みだから、主役いけるって先生言ってたよ。
lines.en: But Riku, your English is near-native, the teacher said you could lead.
lines.style: Encouraging teen girl voice, slightly teasing but supportive friend

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いや無理だって。あの台本、ブルース歌うシーンまであるんだぜ?
lines.en: No way, impossible. That script even has a scene singing blues, you know?
lines.style: Teen boy protesting, half laughing, slightly panicked tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちの劇団、毎年難しい挑戦するから、奮闘するしかないよ。
lines.en: Our drama club tackles tough challenges every year, you just have to push through.
lines.style: Teen girl being matter-of-fact, slightly motivational tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 演劇部のコミュニティーって狭いし、噂もすぐ広がるし、プレッシャーやばいよ。
lines.en: The theater community is tiny, rumors spread fast, the pressure is intense.
lines.style: Teen boy venting honestly, lowered voice, confiding to friend

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫、私も舞台裏で全力サポートするから。一緒に頑張ろ。
lines.en: It's fine, I'll fully support you backstage. Let's do our best together.
lines.style: Teen girl reassuring, warm and bright closing line
